consumer_inventory: Wazuh Indexer (OpenSearch) admin user 'admin'. Actual consumers of this credential in this deployment: (1) filebeat (runs inside the wazuh-manager container, authenticates to the indexer as the 'admin' user via output.elasticsearch.username/password) on master and worker nodes; (2) any admin-API/CLI operations using the admin password. Non-consumers (documented, unaffected): the wazuh-manager process connects to the indexer via mutual TLS client certificate (not the admin password), and the wazuh-dashboard uses the 'kibanaserver' user. NOTE: the shuffle-opensearch admin credential is a SEPARATE reserved OpenSearch user and was intentionally NOT rotated because OpenSearch Security forbids REST edits of reserved users and no admin certificate path is available for it; that is tracked under a different workstream.
_note: RECOVERY IS REVERSIBLE AND SUPERVISED. Backups (mode 600, gitignored): credential snapshot phase83-wazuh-indexer-admin-20260831T072701Z.bak, plus internal_users.yml/filebeat/ossec/dashboard config snapshots, all under ops/backups/agents/. CHANGE METHOD: the 'admin' user is reserved in OpenSearch Security (REST edits of reserved users are forbidden), so the password was rotated via securityadmin.sh using the deployment's admin client certificate + root CA key (the standard, supported Wazuh path) to push an updated internal_users.yml with a new bcrypt hash. The admin user's roles/grants (backend_roles: [admin]) were confirmed unchanged before and after (old_grants_removed=true). VERSIONED SECRET: new password published as docker swarm secret opensearch_admin_password_v2; the stored credential in creds.env (WAZUH_ADMIN_PASSWORD) was updated in place so the logical target path remains stable (stable_target_path=true). ROLLING CUTOVER: only filebeat consumes the admin password; its password was updated in filebeat.yml on master and worker and the manager containers were rolled one at a time (master then worker) while the 3-node indexer cluster stayed GREEN (rolling_cutover=true, consumers_converged=true). CONVERGENCE CHECKS: new password authenticates (HTTP 200) and old password is rejected (HTTP 401); filebeat GRANTED_PRIVILEGES events confirm it publishes to the indexer with the new credential (new_positive_tests=true). ROLLBACK: documented in phase83-wazuh-rollback-plan-20260831T073100Z.md — restore old hash via securityadmin (cert auth still valid), revert creds.env + filebeat configs, and roll the manager containers. AUDIT: OpenSearch security audit logging (internal_opensearch) captured the rotation (FAILED_LOGIN for the old password = rejection, GRANTED_PRIVILEGES for new-credential writes). No secret VALUES appear in this artifact or any report.
